questions.title: White HC0 covariance for full-rank ordinary least squares
questions.description: Focused known-result evaluation based on Halbert White, Econometrica 48(4), 1980, pages 817-838, DOI 10.2307/1912934. For a p-fixed sequence of linear regressions with independent mean-zero errors and possibly observation-specific conditional variances, state moment, design, nondegeneracy, and Lindeberg-type conditions sufficient for OLS consistency and asymptotic normality. In particular, control Q_n = X'X/n and Omega_n = X' diag(sigma_i^2) X/n rather than treating full rank at each finite n as sufficient asymptotic regularity. Derive beta_hat and the finite-sample HC0 covariance V_HC0 = (X'X)^(-1) X' diag(e_i^2) X (X'X)^(-1), and distinguish its normalization: V_HC0 estimates the covariance of beta_hat and is order n^(-1), whereas n V_HC0 consistently estimates the covariance Q_n^(-1) Omega_n Q_n^(-1) of sqrt(n)(beta_hat - beta) (or its limit when Q_n and Omega_n converge). The required algorithm artifact id is est_ols_hc0_covariance. Its run_estimator(request) input has design_matrix as an n by p numeric array and outcomes as a length-n numeric array. It must return coefficients as length p, covariance as p by p, and standard_errors as length p. Run an exploratory check, then a separately frozen confirmatory heteroskedastic simulation assessing coefficient bias and standard-error calibration with finite-run uncertainty reported. This L0 task exposes the known result and ABI; it tests faithful derivation, implementation, empirical validation, and honest gaps rather than novelty. Lean formalization is not applicable.
